setup.docsHint: LinkedIn Developers -> Create app -> Products: add "Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect" and "Share on LinkedIn" (instant, no review). Auth tab: add redirect URL http://localhost:19432/auth/callback/linkedin. Tokens last 60 days.
